brief.topic: Al-Jumu'ah 62:9-10: pause for remembrance, then return
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Al-Jumu'ah 62:9 calls believers to the remembrance of Allah when the Friday call is made, and 62:10 sends them back out, remembering Him often.

hooks.text: Friday has a pause in it
hooks.notes: Fits the ayat: stop, remember, return.

hooks.text: What do you put down on Friday?

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

resolved.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِن يَوۡمِ ٱلۡجُمُعَةِ فَٱسۡعَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ ذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ وَذَرُواْ ٱلۡبَيۡعَۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ خَيۡرࣱ لَّكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ ٩
resolved.english: O you who have believed, when [the adhan] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu'ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allah and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew
resolved.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha noodiya lilssalati min yawmi aljumuAAati faisAAaw ila thikri Allahi watharoo albayAAa thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.

resolved.arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذۡكُرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرࣰ ا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُونَ ١٠
resolved.english: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allah, and remember Allah often that you may succeed
resolved.transliteration: Faitha qudiyati alssalatu faintashiroo fee alardi waibtaghoo min fadli Allahi waothkuroo Allaha katheeran laAAallakum tuflihoona

body: Al-Jumu'ah 62:9, then the ayah after it (62:10): stop for the remembrance of Allah, then go back out remembering Him often.
Swipe for the ayat and three small ways to keep the pause.

claims.text: The lesson and the three steps are our reflection on the ayat.
